properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated August 6, [1936] on stationery from the Manila Hotel; includes report on successful luncheon with influential people in Manila; financial matters; mentions President [Manuel] Quezon, Osmeña, Jones, McArthur, General Holbrook, Secretary Alas, Secretary Vargas, Collector of Customs Aldernacy, Admiral Marquard, Colonel Hodsul, Mr. Pond, Judge [James] Ross, Director General of Posts Ruiz.
